name: Pairing Crack
description: Strike one point and then its mirror so that a crack runs between the two blows.

name: Shardspray Guard
description: Meet a heavy weapon with a guard that sends it back as a spray of shards.

name: Splitting Slip
description: Slip between two attackers and break the ground that joins their footing.

name: Duo Flick
description: Flick two beads of breaking qi at one weak seam so they open it together.

name: Doubled Rend
description: Rend with both hands in turn and tear the target along two lines at once.

name: Pair Nullity
description: Unmake two bolts of qi in the same breath with a palm held to each.

name: Twinned Unpicking
description: Unmake two knots of one curse in an ally together so the curse cannot re-form.

name: Twin Collapse
description: Collapse two neighbouring structures at once so that each falls into the other.

name: Mutual Ruin
description: Ruin the foe's guard and his weapon in the same blow so that each ruins the other.

name: Dual Annihilation
description: Bring two waves of unmaking together across a field and annihilate what stands where they meet.

name: Asunder Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sunders a plank or a rib along its own grain.

name: Gapping Guard
description: Open a rift in the stance that lets a blow fall through and break behind the user.

name: Sundering Slip
description: Slip through a gap in a line of foes and sunder the footing behind.

name: Azure Splinter
description: Loose a pale splinter of breaking qi that bursts into pieces on the target.

name: Pull Asunder
description: Pull two clasped hands of the foe apart with a hard twist from the wrists.

name: Skyrift Thrust
description: Thrust a rift of unmaking through the guard and open the chest behind it.

name: Sundered Hold
description: Hold the foe's gathered qi sundered into pieces too small to cast with.

name: Asunder Remedy
description: Break a creeping curse on an ally into pieces too small to spread and let them fall.

name: Heavy Sunder
description: Bring the whole body behind one sundering blow that splits plate and stone alike.

name: Sundering Veil
description: Hang a veil of sundering before the user that breaks any bolt of qi into harmless motes.

name: Heaven Sunder
description: Split the air and the ground of the whole field along every line of weakness at once.

name: Track Dissolve
description: Strike along one track and dissolve the form of the thing it meets.

name: Dissolution Guard
description: Hold a guard that dissolves a little of every weapon that rests against it.

name: Dissolving Slip
description: Slip out of a grappling hold as the hold dissolves round the wrists.

name: Twofold Dissolve
description: Dissolve both the form and the force of the struck piece with the two tracks.

name: Parallel Nullify
description: Run both tracks against a cast technique and unmake its form and its force.

name: Matter Loosening
description: Loosen the bonds of the matter in a foe's weapon until its pieces slide apart.

name: Dissolution Surge
description: Surge both tracks outward and dissolve the weaker structures within reach.

name: Total Dissolve
description: Drive both tracks through a thick guard and dissolve it from the inside out.

name: Dissolution Edict
description: Decree the dissolution of all form and force in a ring and unmake what the decree reaches.

name: Razing Palm
description: Strike with a broad palm that flattens a raised post or a mound at its base.

name: Levelling Guard
description: Hold a level guard that flattens the blow it takes and shatters its edge.

name: Razing Stride
description: Stride heavily over rough ground and flatten the footing behind the heel.

name: Broad Flick
description: Flick a wide flat disc of breaking qi that skims a short way above the ground.

name: Flatten Press
description: Press down with both palms and flatten the stance of a foe to a crouch.

name: Levelling Blow
description: Bring a levelling blow down on a standing mass until it lies flat.

name: Level Razing
description: Raze the surface of the ground before the user in a wide level swathe.

name: Tumble Quell
description: Loose a tumbling slide of broken ground that holds the foes down.

name: Rubble Hold
description: Drop broken stone about the foe's legs and lock it there with unmaking qi.

name: Razing Sweep
description: Sweep a razing arm across the front and level whatever is built there.

name: Standing Ruin
description: Drive ruin up through a standing structure from its base until it gives.

name: Total Razing
description: Raze everything made by hand across a broad stretch to the bare ground.

name: Oathed Rend
description: Strike with a hand sworn to rend only the one named and no other.

name: Pledge Block
description: Block a blow on a sworn forearm and turn the force into the ground.

name: Bound Slip
description: Slip a pace in the direction named and no further until the oath is kept.

name: Oathflick
description: Flick a bead of sworn unmaking that bursts on the named target alone.

name: Sworn Unmaking
description: Unmake the named target's guard with a blow that no one else feels.

name: Oath Nullity
description: Unmake an attack aimed at an ally who stands within the oath.

name: Oathed Unpicking
description: Unmake the bond of a coercive curse on a sworn friend and leave the friendship whole.

name: Bound Demolition
description: Demolish a ward the oath names without touching a stone beside it.

name: Oath Annulment
description: Annul every attack on those who stand within the sworn circle for as long as it holds.

name: Oathbound Ruin
description: Bring the full ruin of the oath down on the one named and on nothing else.

name: Windward Rend
description: Rend a banner or a sail with a palm swept into the wind.

name: Fracture Gust
description: Fracture an incoming volley with a gust thrown from the forearm.

name: Leeward Slip
description: Slip to the sheltered side of a foe and break the ground he planned on.

name: Squall Ruin
description: Throw a squall of ruin across a small group and tear at gear and cloth.

name: Gust Nullity
description: Unmake a cast technique in the air with a gust that arrives before it.

name: Gust Unpicking
description: Unmake a clinging curse on an ally by blowing the thread of it apart.

name: Rending Front
description: Drive a front of rending wind across the field that unmakes loose structure.

name: Gale Demolition
description: Drive a narrow gale of demolition through the thickest ward upwind.

name: Storm Unmaking
description: Raise a storm that unmakes everything it crosses while the user stands in its eye.
